sources.title: smshahbaj/RIFA-CODE-0.6B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview RIFA Code is a lightweight, coding-focused fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3-.6B, built to write, explain, and debug code while fluently switching between English, Bengali (বাংলা), and Banglish. It is part of the RIFA series of models by SM Shahbaj.
